def Romain(ch):
    R = 0
    ch = ch + " "
    for i in range(len(ch)-1):
        a = convert(ch[i])
        b = convert(ch[i+1])
        if  a < b :
            a = -a
        R += a
    return R

def Afficher(R):
    print(R)
